appDescription: A car app that reads aloud short voice stories that people left at places on the current road, and lets the driver leave a voice story for the place being passed.

function.name: START_STORY_RECORDING
function.description: Starts recording the driver's voice story for the place the car is passing now; recording ends automatically when the driver stops talking.

function.name: MANAGE_MY_STORY
function.description: Handles the driver's own voice story that is being recorded or was just recorded: finish it, send it for review (optionally choosing the original or a modulated voice), record it again, or discard it.

decision.description: FINISH stops recording, SUBMIT sends the story to be shared after review, RERECORD throws away the recording and records it again for the same place, DISCARD throws it away.

voice.description: Optional, only with SUBMIT. ORIGINAL delivers the driver's own recorded voice, MODULATED delivers the story read by a synthetic voice instead.

function.name: HANDLE_ARRIVED_LETTER
function.description: Handles the voice story that arrived for the current road: read it aloud, skip it, or leave or decline a heart after listening.

choice.description: PLAY reads the story aloud, SKIP passes on it, SEND_HEART leaves a heart for the storyteller, NO_HEART declines to leave a heart.
